dr-api-execution-bootstrap 1.0.0

- Initial release of the installer/enforcer skill for direct API execution workflows.
- Automatically applies a direct-first API execution policy to workspace startup files.
- Prefers in-session execution and disables subagent fallback unless explicitly requested.
- Enforces concise responses and minimizes unnecessary progress updates.
- Validates setup with the strongest safe test and reports success or blocking issues precisely.
- Ensures execution policy is persisted without overwriting existing user content.
